subject.title: [Feature]: Channels settings page should always show built-in channels alongside custom channels

question: Should maintainers adopt and refresh https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/544 for this issue, or close it and request a fresh current-main replacement?
rationale: The issue remains source-reproducible, but an open fork PR already contains the focused resolver/test change and blocks a safe duplicate repair lane; its stale checks and old UI path require human handling.

options.title: Refresh or Adopt Linked PR
options.body: Use the existing focused patch as the source, port it to the current UI path, require current proof, and close this issue after merge.

options.title: Request Fresh Replacement
options.body: Close or set aside the fork PR and ask for a current-main UI-only resolver fix with focused regression coverage and browser proof.

recommendation.title: Refresh or Adopt Linked PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing focused patch as the source, port it to the current UI path, require current proof, and close this issue after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the channel UI metadata and gateway catalog path Peter Steinberger previously centralized.
